---
title: "Figure 4. Coding and UTR context of alternative splicing and transcript ends"
engine: knitr
---

## Setup

```{r}
#| label: setup
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = TRUE,
                     cache = FALSE, fig.align = "left", out.width = "100%")
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(ggplot2)
  
})

DATA_DIR <- file.path("data", "Fig4")
OUTPUT_DIR <- file.path("figures", "Fig4")
FONT_FAMILY <- "Arial"
dir.create(OUTPUT_DIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
INPUT_A_DATA <- file.path(DATA_DIR, "Fig4A_AS_structural_composition.tsv")
INPUT_B_DATA <- file.path(DATA_DIR, "Fig4B_context_conservation.tsv")
INPUT_C_DATA <- file.path(DATA_DIR, "Fig4C_sequence_context.tsv")

CONFIG_A <- list(colors = c(FSM = "#A6274B", ISM = "#F15A4A", NIC = "#E2A06B", 
NNC = "#315AA6", Others = "#4D9F50"))

CONFIG_B <- list(colors = c(CDS = "#3F78B5", `5UTR` = "#C58A35", `3UTR` = "#7F9A4B"
), context_levels = c("CDS", "5UTR", "3UTR"), y_range = c(-2.20358336232991, 
7.27204914541972), event_types = c("SE", "A5", "A3", "MX", "RI", 
"AF", "AL"))

CONFIG_C <- list(event_types = c("SE", "A5", "A3", "MX", "RI", "AF", "AL"
), context_levels = c("CDS", "5UTR", "3UTR", "Mixed", "CDS/UTR unassigned"
), colors = c(CDS = "#3F78B5", `5UTR` = "#C58A35", `3UTR` = "#7F9A4B", 
Mixed = "#8A6FB0", `CDS/UTR unassigned` = "#D1D5D8"))

read_input <- function(file, levels = list()) {
  data <- read.delim(file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE, na.strings = "NA")
  for (column in names(levels)) data[[column]] <- factor(data[[column]], levels[[column]])
  data
}

theme_set(theme_classic(base_size = 11, base_family = FONT_FAMILY) +
  theme(legend.title = element_blank(), legend.position = "top",
        plot.margin = margin(8, 10, 8, 8)))
save_panel <- function(name, plot, width, height) {
  draw <- function() if (is.function(plot)) plot() else print(plot)
  grDevices::cairo_pdf(file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, paste0(name, ".pdf")),
                      width = width, height = height, family = FONT_FAMILY)
  draw(); grDevices::dev.off()
  ragg::agg_png(file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, paste0(name, ".png")),
                width = width, height = height, units = "in", res = 600, background = "white")
  draw(); grDevices::dev.off()
  invisible(NULL)
}
```

## AS structural composition

A transcript may contribute to multiple event classes.

```{r}
#| label: Fig4A_AS_structural_composition
panel <- CONFIG_A
table <- read_input(INPUT_A_DATA, list(event_type = c("SE", "A3", "A5", "RI", "MX", "AF", "AL"), 
    category = c("FSM", "ISM", "NIC", "NNC", "Others")))
panel$data <- table

d <- panel$data
d$category <- factor(d$category, levels = names(panel$colors))
p <- ggplot(d, aes(event_type, prop, fill = category)) +
  geom_col(width = .72, position = position_stack(reverse = TRUE)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = panel$colors, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Fraction within AS event")
save_panel("Fig4A_AS_structural_composition", p, 7, 4.5)
```

## Whole-exon conservation

Whole-exon phyloP distributions for coding and untranslated regions.

```{r}
#| label: Fig4B_context_conservation
panel <- CONFIG_B
table <- read_input(INPUT_B_DATA, list())
panel$data <- table

d <- panel$data
d$sequence_context <- factor(d$sequence_context, levels = panel$context_levels)
p <- ggplot(d, aes(x = x, fill = sequence_context)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "#C4C9CD", linewidth = .2) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(ymin = ymin, lower = lower, middle = middle, upper = upper,
    ymax = ymax, group = interaction(event_type, sequence_context)), stat = "identity",
    width = .2, linewidth = .3, outlier.shape = NA) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = panel$colors, labels = c("CDS", "5' UTR", "3' UTR")) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq_along(panel$event_types), labels = panel$event_types) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = panel$y_range) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Mean phyloP")
save_panel("Fig4B_context_conservation", p, 7, 4.5)
```

![](figures/Fig4/Fig4B_context_conservation.png){fig-alt="Whole-exon conservation" width=100%}

[PDF](figures/Fig4/Fig4B_context_conservation.pdf) · [PNG](figures/Fig4/Fig4B_context_conservation.png)

## Event-variable sequence context

Mixed and unassigned regions are included in each event-class denominator.

```{r}
#| label: Fig4C_sequence_context
panel <- CONFIG_C
table <- read_input(INPUT_C_DATA, list())
panel$data <- table
panel$counts <- unique(table[, c("event_type", "total_branches")])
names(panel$counts)[2] <- "n_branches"

d <- panel$data
d$event_type <- factor(d$event_type, levels = panel$event_types)
d$sequence_context <- factor(d$sequence_context, levels = panel$context_levels)
n <- panel$counts$n_branches[match(panel$event_types, panel$counts$event_type)]
p <- ggplot(d, aes(event_type, fraction, fill = sequence_context)) +
  geom_col(width = .72) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = panel$colors, drop = FALSE,
                    labels = c("CDS", "5' UTR", "3' UTR", "Mixed", "CDS/UTR unassigned")) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = paste0(panel$event_types, "\n", scales::comma(n)), drop = FALSE) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(), limits = c(0, 1), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Branches with variable sequence") +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE))
save_panel("Fig4C_sequence_context", p, 7, 4.5)
```
